as_told.title: Bentov killed in American Airlines Flight 191 crash

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about Yitzhak Bentov, the author of a book about consciousness called Stalking the Wild Pendulum. Michels says Bentov died in a plane crash in 1979, and he frames the death as mysterious, hinting it may be more than an accident.
